top_signals.summary: Freeport LNG was ramping natural gas intake back toward normal levels on Monday after maintenance shut one of its three liquefaction trains on Friday, putting a major source of U.S. natural gas demand on track to return to normal levels. Gas flows to the Texas LNG export plant were on track to reach 1.9 billion cubic feet per day on Monday, according to Reuters, citing LSEG data.
